review_description: Solar Wise (Wagga Wagga) was the first to respond to my inquiries and the first to visit my home to establish what I was thinking.  The salesman was not only 'sales enthusiastic' but knowledgeable and open about the limits of his knowledge, as well as very very detailed in how his own solar experience had panned out.  Both positives and negatives.He was not at all pushy and did not make repeated contact to see if we'd made a decision.I visited their work shop and was given a bit of a look through at the equipment that goes into a PV system - not just the panels but also the mounting frame, electrical connectors & wiring (diameter is very important).They contacted to arrange installation on the day before hand.  I don't know how they arrange their scheduling but it was fortunate, for them, that I was available.  Longer notice might be advisable, then again, I'm retired and am home most days so, maybe they found a space that they needed to fill?The four installers arrived on time, got on with it and did the installation in a day.  The following morning, the sparkie in charge came back to check that everything was working and guide my connection to the Enphase websiter and app.I was pleasantly surprised that they even cleaned up after themselves.

SolarWise Wagga was very helpful and patient as I asked lots of questions and worked through resolving our own issues with the wiring of our preferred installation location - the back shed - ours is an old heritage property which comes with all the challenges you expect with one. Installation went smoothly and they accommodated all the requests that typically come from an owner of a heritage property - ie. hide the cabling etc. Staff were friendly and helpful and proactive at resolving issues as they came up.

I received a prompt response to my inquiry through SolarQuotes. The information they provided was clear and the quote received was inline with my expectations and prior experience. Solar Wise managed the entire process, including arranging meter reconfiguration with the electricity retailer. The install team were punctual and polite. The equipment installation was neat and tidy. Overall, the entire experience was of a high standard and I recommend them as a company.
Best products, great service. What more can you ask for.

Alex attended our property for a site inspection and discussion within a couple of days of making contact. He was very knowledgeable and professional and we felt at ease with him straight away. He promised installation within six weeks and he delivered on that time frame.
The whole installation was a joy , it only took less than a day to put up , Everyone at SolarWise Wagga Wagga was courteous and helpful,  Thank you SolarWise Wagga Wagga

Sales/quoting process was very good, clear explanations about the solar system given.Installation very efficient, the team verry polite and friendly and very well organised.Customer service good, about to commence with grid connection and SolarWise will guide me.
HelpfulInstallers were great, punctial & tidyNot sure, how grid has been connected

Firstly just to comment that I feel it's too early to rate quality and value. Tried to avoid answering, but had to estimate. Hard to calculate value until exporting to grid.The local sales person was friendly and full of relevant information. He seemed very knowledgable and spent a long time explaining. Definitely better than talking over the phone. I feel confident about future customer service because it is a local company.

Sales and quoting was thorough and efficient. Installation went smoothly with tidy and professional crew.Grid connection was organised and occurred in short time after install.Overall great service and experience with this team.
Sales and quoting process was good.No high pressure sales.All questions answered very promptly and with good detail
The whole process was seamless and all options explained very well. Very professional team and locals which was a big factor in deciding on installation company.

The salesperson came to my house and went through the whole process and gave me lots of information and websites to look at. The quote wasn't the cheapest but the quality of the product and the support I received were outstanding. the Installation was seamless and the installer was very helpful and again answered all my question
Thanks solarwise for a fantastic installation. Everything was terrific from initial conversations to installation to follow up. Great local company

SolarWise provided a pleasing experience. They provided answers to our queries and advice regarding a suitable system followed by a prompt quote followed by an installation process that was most professional. They were personable, knowledgeable, punctual, tidy and a pleasure to be associated with. We are currently awaiting our energy provider to install the necessary meter to complete the system.

I purchased a 12.24kW 3 phase system from SolarWise Wagga. After doing a lot of research, I enquired about a system and Alex came out and had a look. He knew his product and answered all my questions. He sent me some quotes and helped me understand all my options. After discussing several options, I settled on a 12.24kW system. Because of the size of the system, Essential Energy put a 6kW limit on my feed in. This was unexpected. After learning this, we adjusted the system layout. I have 7.2kW North and 5.04kW West of LG 360W Panels feeding a 10kW Fronius inverter.I had received cheaper quotes, but I went with Alex and his crew as I had heard good things about their work and I wanted a professional neat job. Alex's crew turned up a few weeks later on the day we organised for install. His crew were very well presented. I explained I wanted a nice neat job (I'm a bit OCD with my house) and that's exactly what I got, even up in the roof all the wiring is neatly installed.Once installed, Alex organised the new meter and Essential Energy came and installed it 2 weeks later. (It can take up to 28 days depending on your supplier) Once the meter was installed, Alex came out the next day and reprogrammed it.The system performs well. I exported 46kWh on a clear day mid September, even with the 6kW per hour export limit. The system peaks at around 9.53kW around midday, again mid September.The whole experience was great. I really didn't have to do anything. They took care of it all. They kept me well informed and delivered the job is was hoping for. I would highly recommend SolarWise Wagga to anyone wanting a professional and hassle free experience.

Sales/ quoting process was excellent. Bob explained everything in terms that I easily understood.Installation was punctual, tidy as per plan and installers were friendly and polite.Yes everything was done by Solar Wise or the installers. The system was installed and up and running in about half a day.
Quoting was prompt and professionalInstallation was conducted with courtesy and good interactionCustomer service from the store was prompt and courteous.

Bob, the sales manager was very good at explaining everything to us and helped us all the way through.The installation was done in a prompt and efficient manner.After the grid was connected they attended our house to ensure everything was in order.We feel that we can rely on them to assist us with any problems which may occur.

The sales consultant was professional and courteous. The installation of the panels has been well organised, the guys were efficient and respectful of our property and I would highly recommend Solar Wise.

Extremely helpful in all aspects. Sales person described everything in detail. Installer kept up to date and showed me what had been done. Owner called in and checked still waiting on AGL to connect to grid

On first consultation the consultant, Bob, was helpful and well versed in the products on offer. He explained the relative merits of the various options well and forwarded the details of 3 possible installations promptly.The installation went smoothly - the installers arrived punctually on the agreed day and completed the work in an efficient and timely manner with minimal disruption.Customer service has been a strong point - the grid connection is still a work in progress, well facilitated by the crew at Solar Wise.

Installed but not connected to the grid at this stage. Will be a in a couple of weeks. Installation of the panels and distribution board took less than a day, but waiting on the electricity company to hook it up with a smart meter.

the sales team were quick to get in touch, the sales team were very informative and understanding to my needs. I was able to get the system installed a couple of weeks after as they had a space open up, the installation ran smoothly and the imstallers wer brilliant to deal with , making sure everything was how I wanted it multiple times.
Yes great experience with the team at Solar Wise Wagga. Bob is great to deal with. Looking forward to enjoying the benefits of the system.
From accepting the quote to complete install was 6 business days. Great service and communication.

Came when they saidVery informativeKnew the productQuality componentsExplained quality of various productsDid not push us into any particular product our decision was made on the info provided in our view you get what you pay for.

We purchased from Alexander Manley from SolarWise Wagga Wagga, after much research (thank you Finn Peacock 'solarquotes') and many quotes, because he was one of the few that would travel the 50 kms to speak face to face and discuss the best options for our house after seeing our roof layout.Alex was amazing, no question was left unanswered, supplied many pamphlets of different products, discussed our options and not once was he pushy.A friend of mine had also had his and his parents house fitted by SolarWise many years ago, so not only was he local but has been in this business for many years.The system was fitted in good time and with no problems and despite winter weather is producing well. We are very happy.

This system has a 6 kW Inverter to allow for addition of existing Gross system panels after 31/12/2016 and future expansion. The Inverter also is battery ready and allows for backup on grid failure when batteries are added later this year, so it is more expensive than a simple 4 kW inverter.My roof was replaced the week before installation, so the installation of the system included RE-installation of the existing nine-year-old Gross system PV panels on the new roof.
